heading: derive
sampling: TopView 30 Hz and LargeView 10 Hz are phase-aligned and downsampled directly to 2.5 Hz
excluded: LargeView_density.txt is a single-frame density snapshot
area_source: per-recording occupancy-grid effective area; Geometry.csv contains buildings, fountain, stairs, bollards, and prohibited-area objects, but no camera-footprint boundary that can be matched to each trajectory recording

heading_provenance.meaning: Direction of travel (course-over-ground), not body/sensor orientation.
heading_provenance.computed_from: atan2 of the position delta between each row's neighboring canonical steps (convert.py::_headings).
